<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>기출 구문 검색 · 고1·고2 학력평가</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Source+Serif+4:opsz,wght@8..60,400;8..60,600&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/orioncactus/pretendard@v1.3.9/dist/web/variable/pretendardvariable-dynamic-subset.min.css">
<style>
:root{
  --paper:#eceff3; --card:#ffffff; --ink:#141f33; --ink2:#4d5c74; --ink3:#8593a8;
  --rule:#d6dbe3; --rule2:#e8ecf1;
  --redpen:#b8352c; --bluepen:#1f4fa3;
  --c-rel:#1f4fa3; --c-ger:#b8352c; --c-noun:#0f7268; --c-sp:#6b3fa0; --c-ten:#9a6410; --c-cmp:#a52a6b; --c-etc:#5a6472;
  --sans:'Pretendard Variable',Pretendard,-apple-system,'Apple SD Gothic Neo','Malgun Gothic',sans-serif;
  --serif:'Source Serif 4',Charter,Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  --mono:'JetBrains Mono',ui-monospace,SFMono-Regular,Consolas,monospace;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0}
body{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--sans);font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased}
button,input,select{font:inherit;color:inherit}
a{color:var(--bluepen)}

/* ── header ── */
.top{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:30;background:var(--card);border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.top-in{max-width:1360px;margin:0 auto;padding:14px 20px 12px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px;align-items:flex-end}
.brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin-right:auto}
.brand h1{margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.02em}
.brand .sub{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--ink3);letter-spacing:.02em}
.searchwrap{position:relative;flex:1 1 320px;max-width:520px}
.searchwrap input{width:100%;padding:10px 12px 10px 34px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:2px;
  background:#fbfcfd;outline:none}
.searchwrap input:focus{border-color:var(--bluepen);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(31,79,163,.12)}
.searchwrap svg{position:absolute;left:11px;top:11px;width:14px;height:14px;stroke:var(--ink3);fill:none;stroke-width:2}
.hint{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink3);margin-top:5px}

/* ── layout ── */
.wrap{max-width:1360px;margin:0 auto;padding:18px 20px 80px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:274px 1fr;gap:22px}
@media(max-width:900px){.wrap{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}}

/* ── sidebar ── */
.side{align-self:start;position:sticky;top:74px;max-height:calc(100vh - 96px);overflow:auto;
  background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-top:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:2px}
@media(max-width:900px){.side{position:static;max-height:none}}
.side h2{margin:0;padding:12px 14px 10px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--ink2);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.side h2 .x{margin-left:auto;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--ink3);cursor:pointer;
  border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:2px;padding:2px 6px;background:none}
.side h2 .x:hover{color:var(--redpen);border-color:var(--redpen)}
.mode{display:flex;gap:0;padding:10px 14px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2)}
.mode button{flex:1;padding:6px 0;border:1px solid var(--rule);background:#fbfcfd;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
.mode button:first-child{border-radius:2px 0 0 2px}
.mode button:last-child{border-radius:0 2px 2px 0;border-left:none}
.mode button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
.cat{border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2);padding:8px 0 10px}
.cat:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.cat .cname{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink3);padding:4px 14px 5px;text-transform:uppercase}
.tagrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:3px 14px;cursor:pointer;position:relative}
.tagrow:hover{background:#f4f7fa}
.tagrow input{margin:0;accent-color:var(--ink);flex:none}
.tagrow .nm{font-size:12.5px;flex:1;min-width:0;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.tagrow .n{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink3);flex:none}
.tagrow .bar{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:1px;height:2px;opacity:.5}
.tagrow.on .nm{font-weight:600}
.tagrow.zero{opacity:.34}

/* ── filters ── */
.filters{background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-top:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:2px;
  padding:12px 14px 14px;margin-bottom:14px}
.frow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 10px;align-items:center;padding:5px 0}
.frow .lbl{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--ink3);width:52px;flex:none}
.chip{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:#fbfcfd;border-radius:2px;padding:4px 9px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;
  font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.chip:hover{border-color:var(--ink2)}
.chip[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
.chip.sm{padding:3px 7px;font-size:11.5px;font-family:var(--mono)}
select.sel{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:#fbfcfd;border-radius:2px;padding:4px 8px;font-size:12px}
.toggle{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2);cursor:pointer}

/* ── results ── */
.bar{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 10px;padding:0 2px}
.count{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;color:var(--ink2)}
.count b{color:var(--ink);font-size:15px}
.bar .sp{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.btn{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:var(--card);border-radius:2px;padding:5px 10px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}
.btn:hover{border-color:var(--ink2)}
.btn.pri{background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-color:var(--ink)}
.btn:disabled{opacity:.4;cursor:default}

.list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:2px}
.item{padding:14px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule2);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;gap:4px 14px}
.item:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.item:hover{background:#fafbfd}
.sent{font-family:var(--serif);font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.72;letter-spacing:-.002em;grid-column:1}
.sent mark{background:none;color:inherit;padding-bottom:1px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--c-etc)}
.sent mark.b-rel{border-color:var(--c-rel)} .sent mark.b-ger{border-color:var(--c-ger)}
.sent mark.b-noun{border-color:var(--c-noun)} .sent mark.b-sp{border-color:var(--c-sp)}
.sent mark.b-ten{border-color:var(--c-ten)} .sent mark.b-cmp{border-color:var(--c-cmp)}
.meta{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;text-align:right;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;align-items:flex-end;flex:none}
.src{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11px;color:var(--ink2);white-space:nowrap}
.src .g{color:var(--redpen);font-weight:600}
.typ{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--ink3);white-space:nowrap}
.pick{border:1px solid var(--rule);background:none;border-radius:2px;width:22px;height:22px;cursor:pointer;
  font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;line-height:1;color:var(--ink3)}
.pick:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}
.pick[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--redpen);border-color:var(--redpen);color:#fff}
.tags{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px;margin-top:2px}
.tg{font-size:10.5px;padding:1px 6px;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:999px;color:var(--ink2);
  background:#fbfcfd;white-space:nowrap}
.tg.on{border-color:currentColor;font-weight:600}
.tg.c-rel{color:var(--c-rel)} .tg.c-ger{color:var(--c-ger)} .tg.c-noun{color:var(--c-noun)}
.tg.c-sp{color:var(--c-sp)} .tg.c-ten{color:var(--c-ten)} .tg.c-cmp{color:var(--c-cmp)}
.frag{grid-column:1/-1;font-family:var(--mono);font-size:11.5px;color:var(--ink2);
  border-left:2px solid var(--rule);padding-left:9px;margin-top:4px;white-space:pre-wrap}
.empty{padding:56px 20px;text-align:center;color:var(--ink2)}
.empty b{display:block;font-size:15px;color:var(--ink);margin-bottom:6px}
.more{display:block;width:100%;padding:14px;border:none;border-top:1px solid var(--rule2);background:#f7f9fb;
  font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--ink2)}
.more:hover{color:var(--ink)}

/* ── clip tray ── */
.tray{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:40;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;
  transform:translateY(100%);transition:transform .18s ease}
.tray.on{transform:none}
.tray-in{max-width:1360px;margin:0 auto;padding:11px 20px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tray .n{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:12px;opacity:.85}
.tray .btn{background:transparent;color:#fff;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.35)}
.tray .btn:hover{border-color:#fff}
.tray .btn.pri{background:#fff;color:var(--ink);border-color:#fff}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.tray{transition:none}}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .item{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .meta{grid-column:1;grid-row:auto;flex-direction:row;align-items:center;text-align:left}
  .sent{font-size:16px}
}
:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--bluepen);outline-offset:2px}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header class="top">
  <div class="top-in">
    <div class="brand">
      <h1>기출 구문 검색</h1>
      <div class="sub" id="stat"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="searchwrap">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><path d="M20 20l-4.5-4.5"/></svg>
      <input id="q" type="search" placeholder="영어 단어·구 검색 (예: rather than)" autocomplete="off">
      <div class="hint">여러 단어는 모두 포함 · <b>-단어</b>로 제외 · <b>/정규식/</b> 사용 가능</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="wrap">
  <aside class="side">
    <h2>문법 구문 <button class="x" id="clearTags" type="button">해제</button></h2>
    <div class="mode">
      <button id="mAnd" type="button" aria-pressed="false">모두 포함 (AND)</button>
      <button id="mOr" type="button" aria-pressed="true">하나라도 (OR)</button>
    </div>
    <div id="tagbox"></div>
  </aside>

  <main>
    <section class="filters">
      <div class="frow"><span class="lbl">학년</span><span id="fg"></span></div>
      <div class="frow"><span class="lbl">연도</span><span id="fy"></span></div>
      <div class="frow"><span class="lbl">시행월</span><span id="fm"></span></div>
      <div class="frow"><span class="lbl">문항유형</span><span id="ft"></span></div>
      <div class="frow" style="border-top:1px solid var(--rule2);margin-top:6px;padding-top:10px">
        <span class="lbl">보기</span>
        <select class="sel" id="sort">
          <option value="src">출처순</option>
          <option value="short">짧은 문장순</option>
          <option value="long">긴 문장순</option>
          <option value="rand">무작위</option>
        </select>
        <label class="toggle"><input type="checkbox" id="hl" checked> 구문 밑줄</label>
        <label class="toggle"><input type="checkbox" id="fr"> 해당 구문만 따로 표시</label>
        <label class="toggle"><input type="checkbox" id="tgs" checked> 구문 태그</label>
        <button class="btn" id="reset" type="button" style="margin-left:auto">전체 초기화</button>
      </div>
    </section>

    <div class="bar">
      <div class="count" id="cnt"></div>
      <div class="sp">
        <button class="btn" id="pickAll" type="button">이 화면 모두 담기</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="list" id="list"></div>
  </main>
</div>

<div class="tray" id="tray">
  <div class="tray-in">
    <span class="n" id="trayN"></span>
    <button class="btn pri" id="copy" type="button">문장 복사</button>
    <button class="btn" id="dlTxt" type="button">TXT 저장</button>
    <button class="btn" id="dlCsv" type="button">CSV 저장</button>
    <button class="btn" id="clip0" type="button">담은 문장 비우기</button>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
const D = JSON.parse(document.getElementById('data').textContent);
const TAGS = D.tags, CATS = D.cats, EXAMS = D.exams, ROWS = D.rows;

const CATKEY = {'관계사':'rel','준동사':'ger','명사절·접속사':'noun','특수구문':'sp','시제·태·법':'ten','비교':'cmp','기타':'etc'};
const TYPE = q => q===18?'목적':q===19?'심경':q===20?'주장':q===21?'함축의미':q===22?'요지':q===23?'주제'
  :q===24?'제목':q===25?'도표':q===26?'내용일치':(q===27||q===28)?'실용문':q===29?'어법':q===30?'어휘'
  :(q>=31&&q<=34)?'빈칸':q===35?'무관한 문장':(q===36||q===37)?'글의 순서':(q===38||q===39)?'문장 삽입'
  :q===40?'요약문':(q<=42)?'장문 41~42':'장문 43~45';
const TYPES = ['목적','심경','주장','함축의미','요지','주제','제목','도표','내용일치','실용문','어법','어휘','빈칸','무관한 문장','글의 순서','문장 삽입','요약문','장문 41~42','장문 43~45'];

// 파생 필드
ROWS.forEach(r => { r[4] = TYPE(r[1]); r[5] = r[2].split(' ').length; });

const S = { q:'', tags:new Set(), mode:'or', g:new Set(), y:new Set(), m:new Set(), t:new Set(),
            sort:'src', hl:true, fr:false, tgs:true };
const CLIP = new Map();
const el = id => document.getElementById(id);
const nf = n => n.toLocaleString('ko-KR');

/* ── 필터 ── */
function matcher(){
  const raw = S.q.trim();
  if(!raw) return null;
  if(raw.length>2 && raw[0]==='/' && raw.endsWith('/')){
    try{ const re=new RegExp(raw.slice(1,-1),'i'); return s=>re.test(s); }catch(e){ return null; }
  }
  const inc=[], exc=[];
  raw.split(/\s+/).forEach(w=>{ if(w.length>1 && w[0]==='-') exc.push(w.slice(1).toLowerCase()); else inc.push(w.toLowerCase()); });
  return s => { const l=s.toLowerCase();
    return inc.every(w=>l.includes(w)) && !exc.some(w=>l.includes(w)); };
}
function baseFilter(){          // 태그 조건을 뺀 나머지 조건
  const mt = matcher();
  return ROWS.filter(r=>{
    const e = EXAMS[r[0]];
    if(S.g.size && !S.g.has(e[0])) return false;
    if(S.y.size && !S.y.has(e[1])) return false;
    if(S.m.size && !S.m.has(e[2])) return false;
    if(S.t.size && !S.t.has(r[4])) return false;
    if(mt && !mt(r[2])) return false;
    return true;
  });
}
function tagFilter(rows){
  if(!S.tags.size) return rows;
  const want=[...S.tags];
  return rows.filter(r=>{
    const has=new Set(r[3].map(p=>p[0]));
    return S.mode==='and' ? want.every(t=>has.has(t)) : want.some(t=>has.has(t));
  });
}
function sortRows(rows){
  const a=rows.slice();
  if(S.sort==='src') a.sort((x,y)=>x[0]-y[0]||x[1]-y[1]);
  else if(S.sort==='short') a.sort((x,y)=>x[5]-y[5]);
  else if(S.sort==='long') a.sort((x,y)=>y[5]-x[5]);
  else { for(let i=a.length-1;i>0;i--){const j=Math.random()*(i+1)|0;[a[i],a[j]]=[a[j],a[i]];} }
  return a;
}

/* ── 사이드바 ── */
function buildTagbox(){
  const box=el('tagbox'); box.innerHTML='';
  const seen=new Set();
  CATS.forEach((c,i)=>{
    if(seen.has(c)) return; seen.add(c);
    const d=document.createElement('div'); d.className='cat';
    d.innerHTML='<div class="cname">'+c+'</div>';
    TAGS.forEach((t,ti)=>{ if(CATS[ti]!==c) return;
      const lab=document.createElement('label'); lab.className='tagrow'; lab.dataset.ti=ti;
      lab.innerHTML='<input type="checkbox"><span class="nm"></span><span class="n"></span><span class="bar"></span>';
      lab.querySelector('.nm').textContent=t;
      lab.querySelector('.bar').style.background='var(--c-'+CATKEY[c]+')';
      lab.querySelector('input').addEventListener('change',ev=>{
        ev.target.checked ? S.tags.add(ti) : S.tags.delete(ti); render();
      });
      d.appendChild(lab);
    });
    box.appendChild(d);
  });
}
function updateTagCounts(base){
  const c=new Array(TAGS.length).fill(0);
  base.forEach(r=>r[3].forEach(p=>c[p[0]]++));
  const max=Math.max(1,...c);
  document.querySelectorAll('.tagrow').forEach(lab=>{
    const ti=+lab.dataset.ti, n=c[ti];
    lab.querySelector('.n').textContent=nf(n);
    lab.querySelector('.bar').style.width=(n/max*100)+'%';
    lab.classList.toggle('zero',n===0);
    lab.classList.toggle('on',S.tags.has(ti));
    lab.querySelector('input').checked=S.tags.has(ti);
  });
}

/* ── 필터 칩 ── */
function chips(host,items,set,label){
  host.innerHTML='';
  items.forEach(v=>{
    const b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.className='chip sm';
    b.textContent=label?label(v):v; b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',set.has(v));
    b.addEventListener('click',()=>{ set.has(v)?set.delete(v):set.add(v); render(); });
    host.appendChild(b);
  });
}
const YEARS=[...new Set(EXAMS.map(e=>e[1]))].sort();
const MONTHS=[...new Set(EXAMS.map(e=>e[2]))].sort((a,b)=>a-b);
function buildFilters(){
  chips(el('fg'),['go1','go2'],S.g,v=>v==='go1'?'고1':'고2');
  chips(el('fy'),YEARS,S.y,v=>String(v).slice(2)+'년');
  chips(el('fm'),MONTHS,S.m,v=>v+'월');
  chips(el('ft'),TYPES,S.t);
}

/* ── 하이라이트 ── */
function marked(row){
  const s=row[2];
  if(!S.hl) return esc(s);
  const want = S.tags.size ? row[3].filter(p=>S.tags.has(p[0])) : row[3];
  if(!want.length) return esc(s);
  const pts=[];
  want.forEach(p=>p[1].forEach(sp=>pts.push([sp[0],sp[1],CATKEY[CATS[p[0]]]||'etc'])));
  const cov=new Array(s.length).fill(null);
  pts.sort((a,b)=>(b[1]-b[0])-(a[1]-a[0]));
  pts.forEach(([a,b,k])=>{ for(let i=a;i<b&&i<s.length;i++) if(!cov[i]) cov[i]=k; });
  let out='',cur=null,buf='';
  for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){
    if(cov[i]!==cur){ out+=flush(cur,buf); buf=''; cur=cov[i]; }
    buf+=s[i];
  }
  out+=flush(cur,buf);
  return out;
  function flush(k,t){ if(!t) return ''; return k?'<mark class="b-'+k+'">'+esc(t)+'</mark>':esc(t); }
}
const esc=t=>t.replace(/[&<>]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;'}[c]));
function fragments(row){
  const want = S.tags.size ? row[3].filter(p=>S.tags.has(p[0])) : row[3];
  const out=[];
  want.forEach(p=>p[1].forEach(sp=>out.push(TAGS[p[0]]+'  ›  '+row[2].slice(sp[0],sp[1]))));
  return [...new Set(out)];
}
const srcLabel=r=>{const e=EXAMS[r[0]];
  return '<span class="g">'+(e[0]==='go1'?'고1':'고2')+'</span> '+String(e[1]).slice(2)+'-'+String(e[2]).padStart(2,'0')+' Q'+r[1];};
const srcPlain=r=>{const e=EXAMS[r[0]];
  return (e[0]==='go1'?'고1':'고2')+' '+e[1]+'.'+String(e[2]).padStart(2,'0')+' '+r[1]+'번';};

/* ── 렌더 ── */
let VIEW=[], shown=0;
const PAGE=120;
function render(){
  const base=baseFilter();
  updateTagCounts(base);
  VIEW=sortRows(tagFilter(base));
  shown=0;
  el('cnt').innerHTML='<b>'+nf(VIEW.length)+'</b> 문장'+(VIEW.length?' · '+nf(new Set(VIEW.map(r=>r[0])).size)+'개 회차':'');
  el('list').innerHTML='';
  if(!VIEW.length){
    el('list').innerHTML='<div class="empty"><b>조건에 맞는 문장이 없습니다</b>구문 조건을 줄이거나 검색어를 지워 보세요.</div>';
    return;
  }
  el('mAnd').setAttribute('aria-pressed',S.mode==='and');
  el('mOr').setAttribute('aria-pressed',S.mode==='or');
  more();
}
function more(){
  const list=el('list');
  const btn=list.querySelector('.more'); if(btn) btn.remove();
  const frag=document.createDocumentFragment();
  const end=Math.min(shown+PAGE,VIEW.length);
  for(let i=shown;i<end;i++) frag.appendChild(card(VIEW[i]));
  shown=end; list.appendChild(frag);
  if(shown<VIEW.length){
    const b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button'; b.className='more';
    b.textContent='다음 '+nf(Math.min(PAGE,VIEW.length-shown))+'문장 더 보기  ('+nf(shown)+' / '+nf(VIEW.length)+')';
    b.addEventListener('click',more); list.appendChild(b);
  }
}
function card(r){
  const key=r[0]+'|'+r[1]+'|'+r[2].slice(0,24);
  const d=document.createElement('article'); d.className='item';
  const sent=document.createElement('div'); sent.className='sent'; sent.innerHTML=marked(r);
  const meta=document.createElement('div'); meta.className='meta';
  meta.innerHTML='<div class="src">'+srcLabel(r)+'</div><div class="typ">'+r[4]+' · '+r[5]+'단어</div>';
  const pick=document.createElement('button'); pick.type='button'; pick.className='pick';
  pick.title='담기'; pick.textContent=CLIP.has(key)?'✓':'+'; pick.setAttribute('aria-pressed',CLIP.has(key));
  pick.addEventListener('click',()=>{ CLIP.has(key)?CLIP.delete(key):CLIP.set(key,r);
    pick.textContent=CLIP.has(key)?'✓':'+'; pick.setAttribute('aria-pressed',CLIP.has(key)); tray(); });
  meta.appendChild(pick);
  d.append(sent,meta);
  if(S.tgs && r[3].length){
    const t=document.createElement('div'); t.className='tags';
    r[3].map(p=>p[0]).sort((a,b)=>a-b).forEach(ti=>{
      const s=document.createElement('span');
      s.className='tg c-'+(CATKEY[CATS[ti]]||'etc')+(S.tags.has(ti)?' on':'');
      s.textContent=TAGS[ti]; t.appendChild(s);
    });
    d.appendChild(t);
  }
  if(S.fr){ const f=fragments(r); if(f.length){
    const p=document.createElement('div'); p.className='frag'; p.textContent=f.join('\n'); d.appendChild(p); } }
  return d;
}

/* ── 담은 문장 ── */
function tray(){
  el('tray').classList.toggle('on',CLIP.size>0);
  el('trayN').textContent='담은 문장 '+nf(CLIP.size)+'개';
}
function clipRows(){ return [...CLIP.values()]; }
function dl(name,text,mime){
  const a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([mime.includes('csv')?'\ufeff'+text:text],{type:mime}));
  a.download=name; a.click(); setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1500);
}
el('copy').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const t=clipRows().map(r=>r[2]+'   ['+srcPlain(r)+']').join('\n');
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(t).then(()=>{el('copy').textContent='복사했습니다';
    setTimeout(()=>el('copy').textContent='문장 복사',1200);});
});
el('dlTxt').addEventListener('click',()=>dl('기출구문.txt',
  clipRows().map(r=>r[2]+'\n['+srcPlain(r)+' · '+r[4]+'] '+r[3].map(p=>TAGS[p[0]]).join(', ')).join('\n\n'),'text/plain'));
el('dlCsv').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  const q=v=>'"'+String(v).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"';
  const head=['문장','학년','연도','월','문항','유형','구문'].map(q).join(',');
  const body=clipRows().map(r=>{const e=EXAMS[r[0]];
    return [r[2],e[0]==='go1'?'고1':'고2',e[1],e[2],r[1],r[4],r[3].map(p=>TAGS[p[0]]).join(' / ')].map(q).join(',');});
  dl('기출구문.csv',[head,...body].join('\n'),'text/csv');
});
el('clip0').addEventListener('click',()=>{CLIP.clear();tray();render();});
el('pickAll').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  VIEW.slice(0,shown).forEach(r=>CLIP.set(r[0]+'|'+r[1]+'|'+r[2].slice(0,24),r)); tray(); render();
});

/* ── 이벤트 ── */
let tm; el('q').addEventListener('input',e=>{clearTimeout(tm);tm=setTimeout(()=>{S.q=e.target.value;render();},180);});
el('mAnd').addEventListener('click',()=>{S.mode='and';render();});
el('mOr').addEventListener('click',()=>{S.mode='or';render();});
el('clearTags').addEventListener('click',()=>{S.tags.clear();render();});
el('sort').addEventListener('change',e=>{S.sort=e.target.value;render();});
['hl','fr','tgs'].forEach(k=>el(k).addEventListener('change',e=>{S[k]=e.target.checked;render();}));
el('reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{
  S.q='';el('q').value='';S.tags.clear();S.g.clear();S.y.clear();S.m.clear();S.t.clear();
  S.sort='src';el('sort').value='src';buildFilters();render();
});

el('stat').textContent=nf(ROWS.length)+' sentences · '+EXAMS.length+' exams · '+TAGS.length+' constructions';
buildTagbox(); buildFilters(); render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
